## Architecture registry

**demo**: Demo system.

### Non-goals

- **no-web-ui**: No browser UI.

### Concepts

| Concept | Owns paths | Storage | Env | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| goal (Goal) | `internal/workgraph/**` | work_nodes | WORKGRAPH_DB_URL | Operator goals. *Why:* Goals were scattered; one owner keeps them consistent. |
| scheduler (Scheduler) | `internal/scheduler/**`, `internal/queue/**` |  |  | Runs work. |
| store (Store) | `internal/store/**` |  |  | Persistence. |
| api (API) | `internal/api/**` |  |  | HTTP API. |

### Boundaries

- **writes-through-actions**: `internal/api/**` must not import `internal/store/**`. All writes go through actions.

### Flags

| Flag | Concept | Purpose | Expires | Bead |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `USE_NEW_SCHEDULER` | scheduler | Gate v2 scheduler. | 2026-12-01 | vap-123 |
